reviews.name: Samantha Rodabaugh
reviews.text: I have been to Haylee three times now, starting with just a cut, then went blonde from brown hair. As we all know it's a process when u do that and she did it with grace. Not only did she do amazing on my hair, she is all around an upfront and honest lady! Will definitely be back!!

reviews.name: Quinn Sumrall
reviews.text: Tanya did a great job. She's very kind and worked quickly. I was in and out in about 30 minutes and got a great cut.

reviews.name: April Leatherwood
reviews.text: I brought my son here for the first time for a haircut and we are definitely gonna be repeat customers. Miss Christy did an amazing job on my son's hair and the atmosphere was so nice and positive. I am glad we found this little gem.

reviews.name: Pinx Queen
reviews.text: Haylee is amazing. If you are looking for a great conversation and an amazing colorist, book with Haylee. She went above and beyond for me!
